kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتناوأ (form VI)
# نَتَنَاوَأُ (natanāwaʔu) /na.ta.naː.wa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
# نَتَنَاوَأَ (natanāwaʔa) /na.ta.naː.wa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
# نَتَنَاوَأْ (natanāwaʔ) /na.ta.naː.waʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
